title: Digital Output
text: Write to one or multiple digital output channels, 1 input, 1 output; {Install new board} sets the register a board < no board, {Delete current board} sets the delete the current board, {Board setup} sets the up the board, {Sample time}, {Maximum missed ticks} sets the number of timer ticks by which your model can trail, {Show “Missed Ticks” port} sets the send number of missed ticks to port Missed, {Yield CPU when waiting} sets the yield CPU while kernel waits for hardware, {Output channels} selects digital output, {Channel mode} sets the mode of representing the output, {Initial value} and {Final value}. Values come from the instance.
